usage: eventboat mcp (--stdio | --http) [--config-dir <dir>] [--data-dir DIR]

flags:
  -admin-token string
    	bearer token for the admin/MCP HTTP surface (required for non-loopback binds; also EVENTBOAT_ADMIN_TOKEN / admin.token)
  -config-dir string
    	directory of pipeline YAML files to deploy at startup
  -data-dir string
    	override storage.data_dir
  -ephemeral
    	override storage.ephemeral (in-memory stores)
  -http
    	serve MCP over HTTP (Streamable HTTP) together with the admin surface
  -json
    	machine-readable output for agents and CI (the global --json, also accepted here)
  -runtime string
    	Runtime configuration file (default: ./eventboat.yaml)
  -stdio
    	speak MCP over stdin/stdout (for agent hosts to spawn)
